name: Explain human sexuality and reproductive health
description: Users asked for explanations, advice, or factual information regarding human sexual anatomy, physiology, reproductive health, and interpersonal intimacy. The requests covered a wide range of topics, including contraception, sexual pleasure, erectile function, menstrual cycles, and the health impacts of habits like smoking or abstinence.
